lines.text: I knew you'd come and help, sunshine. I know a kind soul when I see one.
The Circle of Beast Whisperers declared war on me. I'm actually in charge of cleaning this area today...
The footprints are completely covered by the stains... The Beast Whisperers are definitely up to no good.
Hah! I knew you have what it takes!
Look at this mess. They must have possessed an entire nest of Originium Slugs to desecrate my site.
We now have two trails. Which one should we take...?

options: Cleaning up the stains might give us a clue.

r: What's happening, Auntie Yu?

lines.text: This is a major patch of dirt... I have no idea where the prints lead.
Be thorough when cleaning the place and try to find the clues.
This notebook isn't completely soaked... Wait. This is my work log.
Judging from the handwriting of the latest entries... They've been written by someone as young as my grandkid!
This is very odd. The Beast Whisperers don't actually admit children.
Just what on Talos is going on?
Of course, thanks for helping...

options: We should keep following the stains!

r: We should keep following the stains!

lines.text: Are you hurt, Leilei? You almost gave granny a heart attack!
I'm alright, granny. I just got scared by these Originium Slugs...
I'm just glad you're alright...
But Leilei, what are you doing in the wilderness? Granny might lose you if not for this kind young miss!
lines.textM: But Leilei, what are you doing in the wilderness? Granny might lose you if not for this kind young sir!

lines.text: I just wanna help share your work, granny...
I've been wanting to help, ever since I knew about your back ache! See! I wrote down everything I did in your work log. Heheh...
Wait. Where did the work log go?
Well, Mister Leilei. Look at what you've done...
Residential Area? I never cleaned that place. Plenty of pantails from outside were hiding in the city. I don't wanna disturb them.
I saw fowlbeast poop sticking to the walls. So I rode a levitating platform and tried to wipe them clean with a mop.
But the levitating block kept rising higher. I got scared so I closed my eyes while I mopped the place clean.
I just cleaned fowl poop the day before. And they stank so bad! So I decided to be smart and shooed off all the fowlbeasts from Fangxing Avenue...
But they just flew to very high places. Like Chubby Lungs...
I got smart after mopping the fowl poop, so I brought some soap. Cleaning got super quick and effective too!
Effective?! Boy, you just made your granny super angry! What about these Originium Slugs?
I saw an Originium Slug making a mess at the intersection. So, I tried chasing it off before it could leave icky stuff in granny's area.
So I kept chasing and chasing... And then the slug got angry and called all its friends to bully me!
Oh dear. Sunshine, I really appreciate all the help you gave me. My own grandkid turns out to be the culprit!
I was so sure it was the Grimy Mucker or the Beast Whisperers. I really made an old fool of myself.
Alright, Leilei. You owe this young miss a big thank you. She was the one who had to clean the mess you've made.
lines.textM: Alright, Leilei. You owe this young sir a big thank you. He was the one who had to clean the mess you've made.

lines.text: Okay... I'm sorry, miss. Thank you for saving me...
lines.textM: Okay... I'm sorry, sir. Thank you for saving me...

lines.text: As for the stains today, time for you to buckle up and start cleaning. Granny will keep you company.
Yeah! I wanna be the Sanitation Elite of the Month!
You still got a long way to go, Leilei. Miss Sunshine deserves the Elite of the Month.
lines.textM: You still got a long way to go, Leilei. Mister Sunshine deserves the Elite of the Month.

lines.text: Just a while ago, the Tianshi Pillar Array blasted a few Aggeloi. But it scared the pantails and they hid in the Residential Area.
When I walked past and got too close, they became super scared and ran away. So I went somewhere else...
I cleaned up all the garbage there. Before I left, I tried playing with the burdenbeasts nearby. But they got real mean and chased me around all day!
